name: reflection-writer
title: Write an essay, critique it, revise it

origin.source: LangGraph's Reflection tutorial (essay writer: generate <-> reflect loop), rebuilt as an explicit machine

comparison.purpose: A writer drafts an essay, a critic grades it in prose, and the feedback loops back into a revision until the critic is satisfied or the revision budget runs out.

starters: Why cities should ban cars from their downtown cores
The case for a four-day work week
Whether AI tutors help or hurt students

starters.label: Hard topic, strict rubric (expect a revision round)

input.topic: Whether a carbon tax or cap-and-trade better cuts emissions, weighing the strongest objection to your position and citing concrete policy outcomes
